{{dablink|For other uses of the word "tower," see [[Tower]].}}
'''Rena Tower''' is a [[Kandori]] border tower situated to the northwest of [[Heeth Tower]]. Due to the advance of the [[Blight]], it now lies within the Blight itself. Under the command of Lord [[Niach Okatomo|Niach]] of House Okatomo, Rena Tower sent a flash to Heeth Tower before going completely silent. Shortly thereafter, Heeth Tower itself came under heavy attack by a massive Trolloc army, It can be assumed that Rena Tower has fallen to the [[Trolloc]] hordes.
